description: This file defines a set of simple methods related to manufacturing bill of materials (BOM) and product associations in the OFBiz framework, including creating, copying, updating, and deleting BOM associations and related manufacturing rules.

methods.name: createBOMAssoc
methods.description: Creates an association between products in BOM, checking for duplicates before creation.

methods.name: copyBOMAssocs
methods.description: Copies BOM associations from one product to another.

methods.name: eventEditBOM
methods.description: Manages adding, updating, deleting, or copying BOM components based on the specified update mode.

methods.name: updateProductManufacturingRule
methods.description: Updates a manufacturing rule associated with a product.

methods.name: addProductManufacturingRule
methods.description: Creates a new manufacturing rule for a product.

methods.name: deleteProductManufacturingRule
methods.description: Removes a manufacturing rule from a product.
